_source.what: Oracle answers for the agg-stress workload at SF0.1. The queries are IN-HOUSE synthetic stress shapes (no upstream query of this form exists), so every value is the answer this build returns over the pinned graph-benchmark-ldbc SF0.1 store — verified by execution 2026-11-02 (release build, reused store; see the workload README). Rows compare with the graph-benchmark-ldbc lane's no-coercion rules (answers::compare).
_source.data: the pinned graph-benchmark-ldbc store at SF0.1 (graph-benchmark-ldbc CsvBasic-StringDateFormatter, CC BY 4.0 — the same data the graph-benchmark-ldbc, pathdb and snb-bi lanes run; workloads/graph-benchmark-ldbc/data.sha256)
_source.why: an engine-self oracle, recorded so the ratchet catches answer regressions in the fold itself (a fold rewrite that drops or double-counts rows fails the run); it is NOT an upstream answer and never gates on upstream behaviour
_source.regenerate: re-freezing the graph-benchmark-ldbc data set regenerates this file: run the lane, review each answer, re-record (the stream and group sizes in the README's table move with the data). Per scale factor: a store at another SF resolves its own oracle-sf<SF>.json and fails loudly until one exists.
_source.verified: 2026-11-02, by execution over the graph-benchmark-ldbc SF0.1 store: a01 ten most-walked endpoints (1205 endpoint groups, 2,624,450 walks); a02 the first ten (src, dst) pairs of 391,109 groups; a03 the first ten sources of 1199; a04 all ten buckets; a05 the ten widest-reach sources of 1199

a01-endpoint-trail-count.note: ORDER BY paths DESC, endpoint LIMIT 10 — the ten most-walked endpoints; the tiebreak makes the order deterministic

a02-composite-key-fold.note: ORDER BY src, dst LIMIT 10 — the first ten composite groups in key order; every recorded avgHops is an exact binary fraction, so the floats are bit-stable

a03-min-max-per-key.note: ORDER BY src LIMIT 10 — the first ten source groups in key order; creationDate compares as its raw ISO string (uniform format, so lexicographic order is temporal order)

a04-low-card-control.note: the complete fold output — all ten buckets; the sum of paths is 2,624,450, the same stream a01/a03 fold

a05-collect-reach.note: ORDER BY reach DESC, src LIMIT 10 — the ten widest-reach sources; the recorded reach is size(collect(DISTINCT b.ID)), deterministic where collect's own list order is not
